# Vendored MapLibre assets

`maplibre-gl.js` and `maplibre-gl.css` are pinned from MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1 so the dashboard renderer loads without a CDN during demos. Raster OpenStreetMap tiles still require a network connection; locally rendered structural and evidence overlays remain available over the style background when tiles are unavailable.

Source: https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js/releases/tag/v4.7.1
